message: v1.8.19: fix(popup,payments,state): v1.8.19 dark-mode hover contrast, payment modal submit, and explicit state machines
changelog: Swiss Tactile 3D Button Offset Animation (src/popup/styles/11-design-marks.css, src/mobile/styles/09-onboarding-design.css): Restored the Swiss 3D hard-offset hover/press animation (translate(-1.5px, -1.5px) with crisp 2px 2px 0 var(--text-subtle) offset shadow, snapping flush on :active and guarded by @media (hover: hover) and prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)) across action buttons in both the extension and web companion while keeping the dark-mode contrast fixes intact.
